facts.business: Nova Agritech Limited is a research-driven agricultural solutions company offering a comprehensive portfolio spanning soil health management, crop nutrition, integrated pest management (IPM), biostimulants, and precision agriculture products.

auditor.name: CARE Rating Limited
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: Note 26 to the Standalone Financial Statements describes the temporary decline in the Company's revenue during the year due to the suspension of manufacturing and marketing operations of its registered biostimulant products, arising from the delay in renewal of the Fertiliser Marketing Authorization License, which had lapsed on June 16, 2025. The license was subsequently renewed on January 20, 2026, following which the Company resumed its manufacturing and marketing operations. Management believes the decline in revenue is temporary in nature and not indicative of any structural weakness in the Company's business.

key_risks: Suspension of manufacturing and marketing operations due to delay in renewal of Fertiliser Marketing Authorization License for biostimulant products
Revenue decline due to regulatory license lapses
Dependence on dealer and distributor network for sales
Estimation uncertainty in variable consideration (trade discounts, rebates, sales returns)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable, and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements.
